items.headline: Everest ke paas helicopter takkar, 1 ki maut
items.detail: Nepal ke Pheriche me Everest base camp ke paas landing ke dauraan do helicopter takra gaye; Chennai ke 47 saal ke paryatak Vasanth Kumar ki maut ho gayi aur 3 log ghayal hue.
items.exam_angle: Nepal me vimanan suraksha aur Bharat-Nepal sambandh — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Spain mantri ka train hadse par istifa
items.detail: Spain ke parivahan mantri Oscar Puente ne 69 logon ki jaan lene wale train hadse ke baad istifa de diya; saal bhar me yeh doosra bada rail hadsa hai.
items.exam_angle: Spain ki rail suraksha aur mantri ki jawabdehi — antarrashtriya rajneeti ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Borneo me helicopter crash, ek ki maut
items.detail: Indonesia ke sena helicopter ne Borneo ke paas samundar me aag bujhane ke dauraan crash kiya; ek ki maut hui, paanch ko bacha liya gaya.
items.exam_angle: Indonesia me aapda prabandhan aur jungle ki aag — paryavaran ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Iran ka daava: 3 US drone giraye
items.detail: Iran ke IRGC ne daava kiya ki Hormuz ke paas 3 American drone giraye gaye; America ne abhi tak iski pushti nahi ki hai.
items.exam_angle: Hormuz me tanav aur Bharat ki urja suraksha — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: France bank se €100 million cyber chori
items.detail: France ke Credit Mutuel Arkea bank par cyber hamle me hackers ne lagbhag 100 million euro ki farzi len-den ki; grahakon ke khate surakshit rahe aur Paris prosecutor ne jaanch shuru kar di hai.
items.exam_angle: Banking cyber suraksha aur digital dhokhadhadi — banking exams ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Hasina: December me Bangladesh lautungi
items.detail: Bangladesh ki poorv pradhanmantri Sheikh Hasina ne AP ko bataya, maut ki saza ke bawjood December me Bangladesh lautne ka faisla nahi badla; giraftari ya maut ka khatra bhi sweekar hai.
items.exam_angle: Bangladesh ki rajneeti aur Bharat-Bangladesh sambandh — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Komyshuvakha hamle me marne wale 42 hue
items.detail: Zaporizhzhia ke Komyshuvakha gaon me Somvar ko sahayata kendra par hue Russian hamle me marne walon ki sankhya 42 ho gayi; 33 log abhi bhi malbe ke neeche dabey hain aur bachav ka kaam jaari hai.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh aur nagrik suraksha — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Poland me Russia jasusi case me 4 giraftar
items.detail: Poland ki suraksha agency ne Russia ko sainya purje bhejne ke aarop me chaar logon ko jasusi ke aarop me giraftar kiya; do aur logon par sangathit apradh ka aarop hai.
items.exam_angle: Europe me jasusi aur pratibandh — antarrashtriya suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Russell Brand balatkar case me doshi
items.detail: London ki Southwark Crown Court ne comedian Russell Brand ko ek balatkar aur teen yaun hamlo ka doshi paya; saza 9 November ko sunayi jayegi.

items.headline: Amman me chaku hamla, suraksha adhikari ki maut
items.detail: Jordan ki rajdhani Amman me Sri Lanka dutavas ke paas ek hamlaawar ne suraksha adhikari par chaku se hamla kar diya; ek adhikari ki maut ho gayi, ek ghayal hai aur hamlaawar giraftar hai.
items.exam_angle: Jordan me suraksha sthiti aur West Asia me tanav — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Taiwan: Panasonic factory me aag, 2 ki maut
items.detail: Taiwan ke Hsinchu me Panasonic ki factory me lagi aag me do karmchariyon ki maut ho gayi aur paanch ghayal hue; aag ke kaaran ki jaanch chal rahi hai.
items.exam_angle: Taiwan ki electronics supply chain se judi factory — chip udyog ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Europe me bomb dhamki: kai udanein divert
items.detail: Dublin se Rome ja rahi Aer Lingus flight ko bomb ki dhamki par France ke sainya adde Evreux par utara gaya; 151 yatri aur 6 crew surakshit hain, aur Sofia jaane wali teen Ryanair udanein bhi divert hui.
items.exam_angle: Europe me nagrik uddayan suraksha aur dhamkiyon se niptne ki taiyari — antarrashtriya suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Ronaldo ne international football se sannyas liya
items.detail: Portugal ke 41 saal ke star ne video message me kaha, woh November break ke baad No. 7 shirt wapas karenge; 234 match me 146 goal ka record banaya.
items.exam_angle: Khel GK: Purush international football me sabse zyada goal (146) aur match (234) ka record.

items.headline: Hormuz me do tanker, tugboat me aag
items.detail: IRGC ne kaha do tel tanker aur ek tugboat Hormuz Strait me aag ki chapet me aaye; ek tanker 'gair-kanuni' raste par mine se takraya, jabki doosra supertanker aag me ghir gaya.
items.exam_angle: Hormuz Strait aur tel marg: International exams ke liye — samudri suraksha aur vishwa tel vyapaar.

items.headline: France: Desh bhar hadtaal, 70,000 police tainat
items.detail: France me mazdoor sanghon ki desh-vyapi hadtaal aur pradarshan aaj hue; sarkar ne 70,000 police tainat kiye aur 5–7 lakh logon ke sadkon par utarne ka anumaan hai.
items.exam_angle: France aur mazdoor andolan: International exams ke liye — hadtaal, jeevan-yapan aur sarkar.

items.headline: Armenia: Vipaksh ne ekjut hone ka elaan kiya
items.detail: Armenia ke vipakshi dalon ne 'rashtriya ekjutata' banane ka elaan kiya; naya samvidhan kharij karna aur bina ektarfa samjhote ke shanti unki prathamikta hai.
items.exam_angle: Armenia aur Dakshin Caucasus: International exams ke liye — samvidhan, shanti aur vipaksh.

items.headline: France: Blood bank par cyber hamla
items.detail: France ke teen kshetriya blood bank me cyber hamle se khoon rakhne wale fridge ki nigrani vyavastha prabhavit hui; adhikariyon ne kaha khoon ki aapurti par koi asar nahi pada.
items.exam_angle: Cyber suraksha aur swasthya seva: International exams ke liye — mahatvapurna buniyadi dhanche par hamla.

items.headline: Japan: Docomo network desh bhar thapp
items.detail: NTT Docomo ne kaha subah 11:18 baje se pure Japan me call, data aur SMS mushkil ho gaye; isse pehle online shop aur My docomo bhi band kiye gaye kyunki server me ghuspaith ka shak hai.
items.exam_angle: Japan ki telecom suraksha: International exams ke liye — cyber hamla aur aavashyak seva par asar.

items.headline: Nithya Raman LA ki pehli Asian-American mayor
items.detail: Kerala me janmi Nithya Raman ne Los Angeles mayoral chunav me incumbent Karen Bass ko 51.67% vote se haraya; ve shahar ki pehli Asian-American mayor banengi.
items.exam_angle: America ki chunav vyavastha: International exams ke liye — Bharatiya mool ki pehli LA mayor.

items.headline: Hong Kong: Joshua Wong ko 10 saal aur
items.detail: Hong Kong High Court ne Joshua Wong ko videshi taaqaton se milne ke aarop me 10 saal ki saza sunayi; ve January me riha hone wale the.
items.exam_angle: Hong Kong aur rashtriya suraksha kanoon: International exams ke liye — loktantra andolan aur videshi pratibandh aarop.

items.headline: Dow 1,569 ank chadha, Brent tel 8.7% gira
items.detail: Midterm me Democrat jeet ke baad Dow 1,569 ank (3%) chadhkar 53,356 par band hua, jabki Brent crude 8.7% girkar $94.62 prati barrel par aa gaya — Iran yuddh khatm hone ki ummeed se.
items.exam_angle: Bazaar aur tel: America ke chunav aur Iran yuddh ka vaishvik arthvyavastha par asar.

items.headline: South Korea: Hormuz ke paas mission badhega
items.detail: South Korea ne Cheonghae unit ka mission Gulf of Aden se Oman ke dakshin tak badhane ka faisla kiya; P-8A vimaan aur mine-clearing team bhi jodegi, sansad ki manzoori baaki hai.
items.exam_angle: Hormuz Strait aur samudri suraksha: International exams ke liye — tel marg aur antarrashtriya nauvahan.

items.headline: Uttar Korea: Nayi missile ka parikshan, drill bhi
items.detail: Uttar Korea ne Budhvar ko nayi air defence missile ka parikshan kiya aur lambi doori ki cruise missile se ek nakli hawai adde par hamle ki drill bhi ki; Dakshin Korea ki sena ne Sondok se samudra ki taraf kai missile chhode jaane ki pushti ki hai.
items.exam_angle: Uttar Korea aur missile parikshan: International exams ke liye — suraksha parishad pratibandh aur kshetriya tanaav.

items.headline: Indonesia: Rashtrapati ke phone tap karne par barkhast
items.detail: Rashtrapati Prabowo ne apne chief of staff Listyo Sigit Prabowo ko barkhast kar diya; unpar Rashtrapati, mantriyon aur patrakaron ke phone tap karne ka aarop hai, sarkar ne ise deshdroh jaisa bataya.
items.exam_angle: Indonesia: gair-kanuni nigrani aur deshdroh — dakshin-poorv Asia ki rajneeti ke liye.
